summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Enhanced Notes feature. All features working correctly: 4-field form (Subject, Topic, Difficulty, Note Type), new note structure (title, introduction, main_content, examples, key_points, summary), difficulty/type badges, export functionality, history page with updated previews, and backward compatibility with old notes.
passed_tests: Notes form has 4 fields: Subject, Topic, Difficulty Level dropdown (Easy/Medium/Hard), Note Type dropdown (Quick Revision/Detailed/Exam-Focused)
POST /api/notes/generate accepts difficulty and note_type parameters
Generated notes contain all required sections: title, introduction, main_content, examples, key_points, summary
key_points array has at least 5 items (verified 7-8 items in generated notes)
Form validation: subject and topic are required (422 error for missing fields)
Note display shows all sections: Introduction, Main Content with headings, Examples, Key Points, Summary
Note display shows difficulty and note type badges (EASY, QUICK REVISION, etc.)
Sidebar shows difficulty/type badges (E/M/H and QR/DT/EF)
Export button works with Text File and PDF File options available
History page shows updated note previews with difficulty and note_type (e.g., 'Easy · Quick Revision · 8 key points')
History page note detail shows new structure (introduction, main content, examples, key points, summary)
GET /api/history returns notes with difficulty and note_type in preview
Backward compatibility: old notes without new structure still render correctly (shows KEY CONCEPTS, EXPLANATION sections)
seed_data_creation: Created test note 'TEST_Playwright - Automated Testing' with Easy difficulty and Quick Revision type (cleaned up after testing)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Enhanced Notes feature fully tested and working. New note structure includes: title, introduction, main_content (array of sections with heading+points), examples, key_points (5-10 mandatory), summary. History page handles both old notes (key_concepts, explanation) and new notes (introduction, main_content, examples, key_points, summary). Sidebar badges: E=Easy, M=Medium, H=Hard, QR=Quick Revision, DT=Detailed, EF=Exam-Focused.
